parameters.target: Any archived k=2/W=1 COMPONENT_MERGE in (t,t+1s]; compare integer 60Hz ticks.
parameters.model: Standardized logistic regression; fixed total-loss slope L2 penalty=1; unpenalized intercept; Newton fitting.
parameters.scaling: Population mean/SD from two training seeds only; zero SD becomes one.
parameters.control: One nonzero circular social-vector shift per training seed/fold/view; baseline and target fixed, held-out data untouched.
parameters.metrics: ROC trapezoidal threshold curve with exact tie groups; noninterpolated average precision; Brier; ten fixed calibration bins.
parameters.evaluation: Leave one natural seed out; no frame shuffle, class reweighting, held-out tuning or null trajectory data.
